name: GL_USSGL_ACCOUNT_PAIRS
description: GL_USSGL_ACCOUNT_PAIRS has the budgetary account pairs that are automatically debited and credited when you generate a budgetary transaction. Each USSGL transaction code can have multiple pairs, with each pair being debited or credited accordingly.
